requirements.statement: The first-playable inspect, pick-block, inventory move and catalog crafting integration plan closes through production and headless paths.
acceptance: All listed headless tests and production interactions pass through shared public commands.
No remaining surface uses a test-only authority, physical-key business mapping, private focus/context latch or parallel UI root.

requirements.statement: The future science, magic, progress and relations package plan completes without entering the v1 product lock prematurely.
acceptance: Each package passes its independent runtime and persistence gates before product selection.
Removing any optional track preserves unrelated materialized state.

requirements.statement: The complete v1 playable journey passes from clean offline checkout through durable reopen within frozen budgets.
acceptance: Every V0-V9 exit gate is backed by production evidence.
The release journey explores, gathers, crafts, builds, checkpoints, exits and reopens exactly.

requirements.statement: The v1 product closes its launcher, persistence, input, UI, settings, surface-state and legacy-path gaps through the mapped production milestones.
acceptance: The supervisor product entry, durable world/settings paths, compiled input catalog and shared accessible surface route pass one end-to-end replacement-process journey.
No old playable authority, orphan world directory, host-included catalog, physical-key business path, private suppression latch or parallel UI root remains in production.

requirements.statement: The voxel rendering recovery plan closes its mesh, task, streaming, collider, material and budget phases.
acceptance: All P0-P7 exit gates have commit-bound checks and representative client evidence.
No workaround disables culling or removes bounded backpressure.

requirements.statement: All D0-D10 first-demo milestones satisfy their package-driven, durable and playable exit gates.
acceptance: The complete first-demo journey passes from a clean checkout and reopened lock.
D11 remains optional and does not hide D0-D10 gaps.

requirements.statement: All D0-D10 runtime, ABI, persistence, render and supply-chain gates complete without parallel engine subsystems.
acceptance: Client and headless release evidence close every milestone.
ABI and upgrade gates preserve the documented compatibility contracts.
